title: Genesis 1 as a Potential Hydraulic-Engineering Analogy
interpretation: GEI proposes that selected spatial, aquatic, separation, release, and ordering features in Genesis 1 may be examined through a hydraulic-engineering analogy.
scope: Genesis 1, especially the relationship among the deep, waters, firmament, dry land, and subsequent ordering actions.
alternative_interpretations: Ancient cosmological account without engineering referent
testable_predictions: The proposed mapping should produce repeatable structural correspondences that are not dependent on selectively chosen terms.
The interpretation should remain distinguishable from ordinary lexical meanings of the Hebrew text.
notes: This is a GEI research interpretation and is not entered as established historical or linguistic fact.
